dialect.detail: IBM CICS/DB2 mainframe program, part of the HCAZ transaction suite (healthcare patient inquiry). Uses EXEC CICS, EXEC SQL with SQLCA, DFHCOMMAREA, EIB fields (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN).
evidence: COMP usage for DB2 host variables

purpose.domain_detail: Hospital/clinic patient inquiry system; retrieves patient demographic and insurance details from a DB2 PATIENT table via CICS transaction HCAZ option 2.
purpose.summary: HCIPDB01 is a CICS online subprogram invoked by transaction HCAZ when the user selects 'Inquire Patient'. It validates the commarea, then issues a DB2 SELECT to retrieve patient details (name, DOB, insurance card number, address, contact info) by PATIENTID, returning results via the commarea with appropriate return codes.

notable_features: DFHCOMMAREA with EXEC SQL INCLUDE HCCMAREA
EIB fields usage (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN)
COPY HCERRSWS and COPY HCERRSPD for error handling
Intentional bug markers (%bug1, %bug2) suggesting training/education use
DB2 host variable DB2-PATIENT-ID PIC S9(9) COMP
verdict.notes: The presence of '%bug' comments and a note 'Look for %bug to introduce bugs' suggests this may be part of an IBM training or demo system (possibly IBM Z learning materials for healthcare CICS/DB2 applications) rather than live production code, but the code structure itself is production-quality. The HCCMAREA copybook is included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE inside LINKAGE SECTION which is an IBM-specific pattern.
